rule: For each ``*_s100_budget`` run: the 100-iteration moving mean of ``consecutive_success``; the plateau, the mean of its last 300 iterations; the first iteration where the moving mean reaches 95% of the plateau. The budget is the larger of the two surfaces' iterations rounded up to a multiple of 500. A run whose last 500 iterations still rise by more than 5% of their mean per 100 iterations is reported as not converged, and the budget is then the pilot's 3000 iterations. Writes report/study3/tables/budget.json.
